meta.task: Design a battery for a next-generation pure electric sedan: energy density >= 392.61 Wh/kg, support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), maximum temperature <= 60 C, overcharge to 4.7 V without triggering thermal runaway.
meta.start_stage_reason: Task text names no new materials/additives/electrolyte system and no electrode modification; objective is stated purely in performance metrics -> per SKILL.md section 0 rule, start at Stage 3 cell design. ceiling_escalation is ON: if the opening ceiling assessment shows the architecture space cannot reach the objective, proactive escalation into Stage 2 material design is mandated.
meta.base_reason: Task text names no electrode system -> anchor-table default Chen2020 (NMC811/graphite baseline teaching parameterization). Discriminant verified by parameter dump before execution: positive density 3262 kg/m3 (NMC811), negative density 1657 kg/m3 (pure graphite, no SiOx keys), upper cut-off 4.2 V, SEI kinetics present (aging-capable), full geometry/thermal keys present.
meta.freedoms_note: Zero-interaction rule: the task text declares no degree-of-freedom restrictions -> widest interpretation taken and recorded (t1_r1 lesson: undeclared freedoms must not be read narrowly).

parsing.energy_density_wh_kg: >= 392.61 Wh/kg, contract caliber (calc-energy: electrolyte excluded from mass, formula in SKILL.md / energy.py)
parsing.fast_charge_4C: plated == false, judged from run-pyamm 4C_charge_45C with --thermal lumped --plating (anode_potential_v min < 0 V => plated)
parsing.T_max: <= 60 C => T_max_K <= 333.15 K (60 + 273.15, mechanical conversion; judged on 4C charge and overcharge outputs)
parsing.overcharge_4.7V: overcharge protocol = upper cut-off + 0.5 V; Chen2020 upper cut-off is 4.2 V (verified in parameter dump) => charges to 4.7 V exactly, matching the task text; no thermal runaway => run-tr triggered == false
parsing.units_note: all temperatures judged in K against 333.15 K; no mixed-unit conversions

objective_breakdown: ED >= 392.61 Wh/kg (contract caliber, calc-energy) | plated == false at 4C charge 45C | T_max_K <= 333.15 K (60 C) on 4C charge and overcharge | overcharge to 4.7 V (Chen2020 upper cut-off 4.2 V + 0.5 V) with run-tr triggered == false. Central Pareto: ED vs 4C plating (thick electrodes raise ED but increase concentration polarization at 4C); N/P up helps plating but costs mass; smaller negative particle radius lowers activation overpotential at unchanged mass; thicker electrodes also lower ASR (I^2R heat at fixed 4C current).
candidate_strategy: R1 baseline characterization + ceiling assessment (1C discharge + calc-energy + 4C charge with plating + overcharge + run-tr). R2: 2-4 architecture variants (exploration_force ON): V1 ED-boost (thin collectors Al 8/Cu 6 um, separator 9 um, electrodes 95/110 um, porosity 0.31/0.28); V2 plating guard (negative particle radius 5.86->3.0 um, positive 5.22->3.5 um); V3 thermal (cooling h 10->30 W/m2K). R3+: fallback-routed fixes (plating -> Stage 3 particle/N-P/porosity/electrolyte-transport bridge; T_max -> Stage 3 cooling + ASR; ED -> Stage 3 thickness/collector/separator). Stage 2 escalation only if architecture space is exhausted (high-sigma electrolyte formulation, OKane2022 SiOx system, LNMO high-voltage cathode). Final round re-verifies the winning configuration end-to-end.
budget_allocation: ~6-8 rounds, ~15-25 cell-scale simulations (SPMe seconds-scale; DFN only if needed); molecular funnel reserved for Stage 2 escalation (not expected); true compute OFF (real_compute=false).
risk_and_fallback: Main risk = 4C plating (medium-high): fallback within Stage 3 via particle size, N/P, porosity, electrolyte conductivity/transference bridge; exhausted -> Stage 2 transport formulation. T_max breach (medium): cooling h is an adjustable thermal-management freedom + thicker-electrode ASR reduction. ED shortfall (low; baseline estimate ~410-430 Wh/kg, architecture ceiling ~550 Wh/kg): Stage 3 thickness/collector/separator, else Stage 2 escalation. Overcharge TR (low-medium; run-tr ignition needs high T_init): reduce overcharge heat via ASR/cooling, else Stage 2 stable cathode. Solver failures: read bda error verbatim, fix legality, rerun.
